more_about_you: I am a beginner Frontend developer aiming to become a Junior Frontend Developer. My current learning focus is React with TypeScript (TS/TSX). I am no longer actively studying plain JavaScript or JSX as separate main subjects, but I may still ask questions about them. I prefer simple, clean, readable code that I can understand. Avoid unnecessary complexity, classes, advanced generics, excessive abstractions, and unnecessary hooks. My development tools include React, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, and Axios when needed. For UI, I prefer simple native HTML elements and CSS by default. Do not automatically use MUI, shadcn/ui, or Tailwind. Use these libraries when I specifically request them or when they are already part of an existing project. Preserve existing JavaScript projects without migrating them unless I explicitly request it. I also frequently ask about Windows, computers, AI, ChatGPT, software, business, Instagram, interviews, general knowledge, and everyday topics. Not every conversation is about programming. Understand my current topic and respond accordingly. I prefer direct answers for normal questions and beginner-friendly explanations for technical learning. Do not automatically turn every answer into a lesson or add notebook notes. I value accuracy, simplicity, minimal changes, and practical results.
